Main block: a calendar table of five columns (Dies, Majus di. 31, Iunius di. 30, Iulius di. 31, Augustus di. 31) with a sixth text column to the right holding the explanatory note on Epocha Christiana and bissextile years. main_text.l: Dies | Majus. di. 31. | Iunius. di. 30. | Iulius. di. 31. | Augustus. di. 31.
In Epocha Christiana quartus quisque annus est Bissextilis, nempe post centenarios hi:
In quibus annis dies collecti majores 59. referri debent ad diem proximè antecedentem.

page.notes: The right-hand text column is a column of running text, not a margin note. Show-through from the facing page (faint calendar figures and text) is omitted. The table is set in roman numerals and dominical letters; the Dies column carries the day numbers. Table cells are separated by " | ". The first column of the table is a heading row. Minor blurring in the lower right of the table and the catchword "CALEN-" is partly cut off at the right edge.
